Real Litecoin testnet4 blocks, unchanged, from github.com/ltcmweb/ltcd
(wire/testdata, commit 9cec00158a8c9843ef2b51340db728c0d18af6f0, ISC licence).
Each file is a full serialized block as relayed on the network.

- testnet4Block1821752.dat: before MWEB activation, 3 txs.
- testnet4Block2215584.dat: first block with MWEB transactions (peg-in, HogEx), 5 txs.
- testnet4Block2215586.dat: MWEB block.
- testnet4Block2319633.dat: coinbase + HogEx, with an MWEB block.
- testnet4Block2321749.dat: 4 txs, the last a HogEx, with an MWEB block.
